## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Hessen lights up on the map of Germany.
> Hessen | Landeshauptstadt Wiesbaden

[dramatic] [[Hessen]], Hesse, is in the middle of the country. Its capital is Wiesbaden, but its biggest city is Frankfurt, home of the European Central Bank and one of Europe's busiest airports.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Hesse, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> HESSEN

## On the map

{Q368}

> SCENE (question): Question card #368. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Hessen?]] Which federal state is Hesse?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[3]]. Number three: the middle of the west of the country.


{Q367}

> SCENE (question): Question card #367. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Hessen heißt …]] The state capital of Hesse is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Wiesbaden.]] The other three are real cities in Hesse, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q365}

> SCENE (question): Question card #365. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Hessen?]] What colors are on the state flag of Hesse?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[rot-weiß]]. Red and white, the colours of its lion.


{Q361}

> SCENE (question): Question card #361. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Hessen?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the state of Hesse?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 1]], picture one: a lion striped red and white, on a blue shield.


## How it's run

{Q362}

> SCENE (question): Question card #362. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Hessen?]] Which of these is a district in Hesse?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Main-Taunus-Kreis]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Ammerland]] is in [[Niedersachsen]], [[Altötting]] is in [[Bayern]], and [[Prignitz]] is in [[Brandenburg]].


{Q363}

> SCENE (question): Question card #363. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Hessen gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Hesse elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q364}

> SCENE (question): Question card #364. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Hessen bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are people allowed to vote in local elections in Hesse?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[18]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from eighteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q369}

> SCENE (question): Question card #369. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Hessen?]] What is the head of government in Hesse called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q370}

> SCENE (question): Question card #370. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Hessen nicht?]] Which minister does Hesse not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q366}

> SCENE (question): Question card #366. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Hessen über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information about political issues in Hesse?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Wiesbaden, rot-weiß, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Wiesbaden]]. [[rot-weiß]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
